steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Lada's... not here either?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (She sure has been busy lately.)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: C-Captain!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hm? Oh, hey, Mousse.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You did nice in that last combat drill.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Heheh. I went through Leto's brutal training course, after all.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? Rosalind?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Mm-hm! When the new squad rosters were posted, I saw you were my captain... I remembered the two of you were best friends, so I went and asked her how best to work with you in battle.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: She agreed to train with me straight away! And she taught me this little trick for when I fight alongside you...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What's the trick?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: She said, 'If Sonya heads up, just head up with her!'

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That dumbass... Grrr... I was wondering why I couldn't even find her. She was training with you, huh?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: No, not just me... there's been a lot of operators fighting for the chance to train with her.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: And the way it's been as of late, once she's in the training room, she spends the whole day there... *sigh* I wonder when I'll ever have energy as exuberant as her?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator A
steps.text: Jeez, you don't see that every day.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator A
steps.text: I've never seen a newbie like that. Fresh transfer from Logistics to the front line, if you could believe it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator A
steps.text: Bored clean through a solid steel plate with that custom crossbow she's got... I'm sweating here!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator B
steps.text: That's not even the scariest part... did you hear? Stormeye was talking up the newbie hard during combat drills. A first for him.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Is that Natalya they're talking about? No way.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Not like that should be surprising. Weird. The hell am I feeling...?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Shouldn't I be happy for her?)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Whatever, this sucks... Guess I'll take a look. Should just about be there.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Is that voices from inside? Sounds like a lotta people...)
Huh? Is someone at the door?
Allow me, Royal Detective, to get to the bottom of this.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Z... Zima! I assume you're here for Istina?

steps.name: May
steps.text: She's... currently sharing her thoughts on A Winter Campfire with us! This book right here!

spans.text: She's... currently sharing her thoughts on
with us! This book right here!

steps.name: May
steps.text: I'll bring her over!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: W—Wait, no, no need...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Not like it's anything important. I'll just come back a little later.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: *huff*.
Five days later...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Maybe Rosalind's here?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, nope. Didn't think so.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Took me the whole morning just to fry one pirozhki. Still doesn't taste half as good as Lada's.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I went and borrowed A Winter Campfire from May. Should be able to finish reading it tonight.

spans.text: from May. Should be able to finish reading it tonight.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And that black tea still tastes so bad I wanna die... but I get it now. Natalya's been relying on that weird mouthfeel to stay awake the whole time!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Nowadays...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Life's simple... for us, the USSG. It should've been like this before, shouldn't it?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Uh... Nearl. You heard all that?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Whatever, perfect timing.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm not totally cool with the squad assignments. I think Istina, Leto and the rest would do better on a team with me.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You... C'mon, you're messing around, right? We've always been a team.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Our squads at current are not based on whether its members come from the same place, or how deeply they know each other.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: It is Rhodes Island strategic necessity. You're bound for the battlefield.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Our plans are made in the wake of the most responsible decisions, with full stock taken of our mission objectives, coupled with the best of every operator's individual abilities and team synergies.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: How come you never seem to get pissed off?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Zima, very soon you'll be leading a reorganized squad to carry out your mission.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You must remember: here and now, you are a team captain.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph... yeah, I hear that. 'Captain.'

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So that's my new title, huh?

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Phew... oof, it gets real cold here at night...

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Captain, you want a smoke? Warm yourself up?

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: I mean... I assume you're old enough?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't smoke.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Also, you wanna be careful.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ursus gets real dry this time of year. One spark can catch the moment it hits grass.

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Got it. Guess I won't smoke either.

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Eesh... it's freezing... say, don't you guys think this mission's a little slow-going?

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Do we really need this many hands looking for one shipment of lost meds?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: I... I believe Nearl must have had strategical considerations in arranging for us to go!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: *sigh* Arrangements, my butt.

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: We're a bunch of rookies, we don't have any actual combat experience. What, are you hoping commander's about to send us on harder missions?

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: I'm just sad I didn't get put in the same squad as that one Medical girl I trained with. I was even gonna...

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Wait! Guys, look...

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: There—There's fire that way!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: C'mon. We're gonna check it out.

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: O—Oh, jeez... this whole tent got burnt down...

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Rhodes Island logo... this was one of our temp stations.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Are the airtight containers in there the missing medical supplies?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna, compare those with the designs for Medical's pharms.

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Um... Captain, Istina's not in our squad...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Goddammit.

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Captain, permission to speak freely, you've been kind of distracted this whole mission.

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: You, Istina and Rosa and the rest were one student group, right?

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: But we're a whole squad here. Didn't The Radiant Knight tell us to trust in our teammates out in the field?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Captain, I've made a rough check. That should be the lost shipment in the tent.

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: It's gotta be! The packaging's the exact same as the stuff awaiting transit on the landship.

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Let's go, c'mon, everyone ease up! Let's bring the spoils of victory home... Who knew it'd be this easy!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wa... Hey, wait!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Geugh...

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Wh—Who are you guys? Get outta my way!

steps.name: Surly Bandit
steps.text: No more funny business!

steps.name: Surly Bandit
steps.text: Last one was your arm. The next one's aimed at your head if you try anything!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Who the hell are you people?

steps.name: Indifferent Bandit
steps.text: No comment.

steps.name: Indifferent Bandit
steps.text: Drop your meds, your equipment, and any other valuables you have right here, and we'll let him go.

steps.name: Indifferent Bandit
steps.text: Bratany!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Captain...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Seanson, you hold steady.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Huh? Captain, don't do anything rash...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Mousse! We're going in!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: R—Roger!

steps.name: Surly Bandit
steps.text: Gargh!

steps.name: Indifferent Bandit
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, kid.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're their boss, aren't you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Speak!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: He's passed out.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph. Guess he couldn't take a beating.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Seanson, you okay?

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: I'm surprised you remember my name, Captain.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: It's okay, my wounds aren't deep... I can do some simple first-aid on myself...

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Swear my heart was about to leap out of my mouth, though.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: I don't think I'm fit for the battlefield... I need to hand in an application to command later, see if I can't get transferred to Logistics or Medical.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Coward.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Lucci, how are things in the tent?

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: I gave a search. Those supply boxes are definitely Rhodes Island's, without a doubt.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: But they're all empty inside! The pharmaceuticals are gone!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Dammit! Wake up, you dumbass! Quit playing dead!
Zima seizes the bandit leader by the scruff and tosses him to and fro—vigorously enough to throw the goods in his pockets all across the floor.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Is... Is that... a Peterheim Middle School... student ID?

steps.name: Indifferent Bandit
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Morning, bozo.

steps.name: Indifferent Bandit
steps.text: Y—You were in the forest... Where are we? What are you doing with me? Where are my bratany?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: 20 Questions the second you wake up, huh? You're a pain in the ass.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We brought you back, gave you a checkup, put you on energy supplements for your malnutrition, and got you permission to stay in a dorm. Feel free not to thank us, I guess, but—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: At least show a little respect?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Daniil.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: How do you know my name...?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Your student ID.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Didn't think I'd run into a schoolmate in some crappy forest all the way out there.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You don't know me?

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: General Zima? I didn't even recognize you.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright, whatever, you remember me. That makes this a lot simpler.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I've got one question, that's it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The medical stuff. Where did it go?

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: I sold it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You sold it? Then where's the money?

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: ...Spent it all.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Are you serious?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You dickhead... If only I knew you'd pull this shit. Should've let those noble kids beat on you longer.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Okay. You sold it. So tell me about your buyer, your broker, and the amount of money your stolen goods got, and don't miss a single thing.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You need to understand—Rhodes Island might be housing you for now, but if you don't cooperate, we can just hand you over to the Ursus police.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: I must be dreaming. General Zima using 'I'll sic the police on you' to threaten me... It looks like everyone's changed since Chernobog.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: General Zima... no, Sonya. I would've probably done as you told me if we were back in Peterheim.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: I had no choice there, after all. It was either follow you, or beg those noble shitstains for forgiveness as they kicked me about.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Who says you can't follow me now? You'll be part of the USSG until whenever.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: This is Rhodes Island. It was Rhodes Island that sheltered us, and brought us out of Chernobog.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I don't actually know if you can join too... but I figure as long as you're wiling to work, it should be fine.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: Hmph. The Ursus Student Self-governing Group, was it? What a nostalgic name.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: If Anna's here too, then why wasn't she with you out there? Those two bratany in your squad probably don't have half the brain cells combined that Anna did.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Grr. Those are my squaddies. I won't have you talking shit about them.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And Anna's... the group's got their own things to do.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: Hmph, their own things. You weren't really thinking you could lead the USSG your whole life, were you?

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: If Rhodes Island is sheltering you, then they must have taken in Anna and the rest too.

steps.name: Daniil
steps.text: So how could they have clung to your side forever, the way they were before?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Of course they're not gonna be with me all the time, and that's for the best.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I never really planned for the future, anyway.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I used to think, if we all made it out of Chernobog... then no matter what the future brought, it couldn't be worse than that, could it?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Real talk, Rhodes Island is just fine to us now. We got used to life here, and we've all found our own thing to do.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: For me, Peterheim's in the past. Same for the USSG.
Five days ago...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: H—Huh? Disband?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You want to disband the USSG?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'mma sniff a sec... doesn't smell sweet... you're not honey-drunk.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wait, what's this crazy talk, then?!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's not crazy talk. It's my official decision.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Natalya just got back. Didn't we agree to welcome her home together? To celebrate her achievements?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Even if you're of a mind to disband the USSG... now's not the time to bring that up, is it?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: No. Now's the perfect time.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Our group was founded on the idea that we'd support each other through those hellish days.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But now, we're out. All of us in the USSG have found stuff we'd rather put our energy into aboard Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Like Natalya has. She started out not knowing how to fight at all, now she's posting great scores in combat drills... She's the best out of all of us, the way she's changed.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I used to worry I wouldn't make a decent leader... Maybe I've earned your trust and support after so long.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But that doesn't mean I can hold onto my position forever.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I used to be the USSG's leader, now I'm the captain of a Rhodes Island advance squad... and there's more possibilities out there for Sonya's future.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: All of your futures.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Um—I—still don't really get it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: How does it actually affect us if the Group disbands?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Even if the USSG's gone, the five of us will still be together, right?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Lada, this is different. Don't you wanna be a great chef? And Anna says she wants to go study at university.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: For our past selves, all of that was empty dreams. But now, we have better footing, and I think... no, I'm sure everyone's got a way better future in store.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We're gonna be more than just members of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. We're all gonna better ourselves.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Well, I'm lost for words. Hats off to our leader.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I certainly never expected... that the first to leave the Ursus Student Self-governing Group would be you, of all people.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's not just me leaving, it's the USSG disbanding! You're all free now!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Sonya.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Is that how you've decided to resolve our futures?
I mean... I assume you're old enough?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Urk...
So how could they have clung to your side forever, the way they were before?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Urk...
How does it actually affect us if the Group disbands?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Blughk—
She vomits, cleanly as could be.
Sonya, you know you're not omnipotent.
This is for the best for every single member of the USSG.

a.text: The water in the toilet basin becomes a whirlpool, like it's about to suck me in, pull me away from a life where they exist.
Right now, my future lies before me.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Seriously... I thought we'd get to rest up for a while.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: All we had was a few days back on the landship, and now they sent us out to a place like this.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: It's way colder than last time.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: Plus our captain still acts like she's got it all to win... Just kill me.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: You think? She looks to me like she's just forcing herself along.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Actually, did you hear? That student group of theirs broke up!

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: Huh? Is she for real?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What the hell are you two bitching about now?

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Oh, Captain! No bitching here, none at all!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, you're off the hook this time.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Lucci, pass me a smoke.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: Captain, The Radiant Knight went out of her way to give me a warning.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: I'm never gonna hand out smokes again. Don't hurt me for it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh. Screw you, Nearl, stepping into my business.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Oh, yeah, uh, Captain...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Did Daniil really just tell you the village's location like that?

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: They hid that many medical supplies in this one village?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It was Nearl who told me... Literally no idea how she got it out of Daniil, though.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But she's always going around all like 'just leave it to me,' so I'm not that surprised.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: But is there really going to be an inhabited village... in a place this desolate?

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: Captain, you don't think The Radiant Knight's testing you, do you...?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: L—Look!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Over there, I think that's an old man.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: What could it be, youngster?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Fresh faces are seldom sighted, out here in this tundra.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Is there a village around here?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Do you see that hut over there? Go past it, and you'll find our village.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You don't... uh, excuse me, but you wouldn't happen to know a Daniil, would you?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Daniil, eh...?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Chi—Chief! Trouble!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: There's a fire in the village! It's about to reach the storehouse! All our food for the winter is in there!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Captain Zima! We're done evacuating all villagers on the east side!

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: North side villager evacuation complete!

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: West and south villagers are all evacuated too!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Got it. Mousse, you go double-check the headcount with the village chief. Then help them put out the fire. These villagers built their own houses, brick by brick, so every room you can save is a win.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: R—Roger!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Seanson, Lucci, with me. This next part of the job's gonna be tricky... We need to head into the storehouse, and get the medical supplies out.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: What? So they were in the village!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah... I'll tell you the whole story after we're done here.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: But... you're telling me it's all in there? Captain, that's not a small fire.

spans.text: in there? Captain, that's not a small fire.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I know, and this isn't an order.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you don't want to go, I'll go by myself.

steps.name: Lucci
steps.text: Captain, this isn't a want-to-or-not kind of scenario...

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: Dedushka, dedushka, will that bratan come back to help us?

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: In the spring, he said he'd return by autumn.

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: And then autumn came and he did, don't you remember? And he harvested the grains with us.

steps.name: Old Villager
steps.text: You silly little fool. That boy didn't say he'd come back in winter.

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: No, he said he'd come back the next time we're out of rye bread.

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: But—but...

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: ...Dedushka, weren't you just saying, we might not have bread to eat this winter?

steps.name: Young Villager
steps.text: So the bratan must be coming back soon!

steps.name: Old Villager
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Old Villager
steps.text: Come, sweet child. Be good now, your babushka is waiting for us over there.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Change of plans. We rescue the villagers' food first.

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: B—But, Captain, given the situation, these villagers could well be in cahoots with Daniil!

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: They stole our stuff, and we're going to help them?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's two different things... C'mon, you guys, with me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's an order this time. And if we can't get the medical supplies thing squared off... I'll take the blame.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Say, how much grain do you figure could be left in there?
Given the present conflagration, the portion closest to the fire's origin is out of the question. Still, at least some of the outer portion should remain.
Hm? I don't think so~ There's still a chance for the inside part, it might just be a little overbaked!
After all that training, we finally get a shot at the real thing, huh? Move move move, girls, full steam ahead!
All else being equal, we've arrived in time. If we concert our efforts, perhaps we can still avert complete disaster.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Y—You guys...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you doing here?
Back then...
You! You idiot... Do you even know what you've done?

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: It was an accident...
Save it! Quickly, with the water! Bring the water!
It's no use! This little water's barely enough!
Th—The fire's spreading too fast!
Dammit... What are we waiting for, then?! Run!

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: N—No... This is our last reserve of food...!
Forget her! Let's run!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Daniil left us a letter. He said you might need the USSG's help, Sonya.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: After reading it, we went looking for Nearl. She told us the location of this village.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That dumbass, Daniil...

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Belay it, Sonya. No more hesitance.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The five of us should be plenty! What about those two, though?

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Seanson
steps.text: We'll go save the medical supplies!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Everyone, let's do this! After we're done, I'll make super-tasty grenki for all of us!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya. Let's go together.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna, you absolutely didn't need to come.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The USSG's already disbanded.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes, by your personal statement. Being the initial proponent of the Group's establishment, shouldn't you solicit my view?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Not to mention those of Lada, Rosalind, and Natalya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Okay, so what are your views?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We all object.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I can more or less guess what your thinking ultimately was.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: To be honest, I've been deliberating over the USSG's continuation myself...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If we never encountered Rhodes Island, our lives might now be much the same as Daniil's.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But you see, Sonya... even for all Rhodes Island gives us, it doesn't mean we must lose anything.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We're not even in the same squad anymore.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Come, help me out.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: This bundle's quite the heavy load.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'll carry this side. We need to hurry up.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We may not be in the same squad anymore, true, and I estimate we'll only be further split up in future, but...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: At the very least, when you think to bear something alone, we'll come to your side like we are now...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Because we are eternal comrades.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Weird...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I can't believe the five of us are still together.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And we're facing a fire, just like we did back then...
If not for this fire...
No, there is no if.

a.text: Even if this fire is already lit...
Still we will link our hands, sing and skip.
Still we will lift the same food one and all.
The frozen earth will thaw to loose soil.
No longer will the seed cling to the seed's false name.
Once the winter night is through, she will spark tender, small blossoms.
